hotels.title: Gold Coast Beachfront Self-Contained Escape on Coolangatta Beach with Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Discover the allure of sunny Queensland with a stay along the beautiful Coolangatta Beach. Perfectly positioned on Marine Parade, this beachfront escape is a stone's throw from the world-renowned Snapper Rocks surf break and the vibrant Coolangatta dining precinct. With spacious self-contained studios and apartments, a heated swimming pool, tennis courts and a fully equipped gym, the retreat offers a perfect blend of relaxation and activity.
